intro: FB2 to PDF converts FictionBook books, very common in the digital libraries of Russia and Eastern Europe, into PDF. An FB2 is a single XML file that holds the text structured in sections, the book's details and the embedded images; few readers and programs open it, while a PDF can be read and printed anywhere.

Before converting it we check that the XML is well formed and read it with a safe parser that rejects XML entities, a well-known attack route. Books that link to files that are not inside them do not get through either. Then Calibre's ebook-convert lays it out on our server, as an isolated process with no network access.

You can choose the paper, A5 by default, A4 or Letter; the margins, between 0 and 50 mm, 15 by default; and the base font size, between 6 and 36 points, 12 by default. With «Table of contents at the start», on by default, the PDF begins with the list of sections and their pages: Calibre puts it at the end and we move it to the front, with the contents pages numbered in roman numerals and the book from 1.

Each book gives its own PDF and, if you upload several, also a ZIP with all of them. The PDF is subject to your plan's page limit: 100 without an account, 300 with a free account and 2000 with Pro. If a book does not fit, try larger paper or a smaller font.
steps: Upload one or more FB2 books.
Choose the paper, the margins, the font size and whether you want the table of contents at the start.
Download the PDF of each book or the ZIP with all of them.

faq.a: Not directly: unzip the archive and upload the .fb2 file inside it.

faq.q: My FB2 gives an invalid file error, why?
faq.a: It happens when the XML is malformed, for example with unclosed tags or a wrong encoding, or when it declares entities. Open it and save it again with an FB2 editor or with Calibre and try again.
Yes, the images embedded in the FB2, such as the cover or the illustrations, appear in the PDF alongside the text.
